about.title: Three crafts, one hand.
about.lede: Before the brush became the main tool, these same hands cut hair, arranged flowers and drew for years — each one taught something about colour, form and patience that eventually came together in art. I'm a colorholic: colour is the language I think in.

art.title: Art
art.text: I paint and draw in several techniques — acrylic, oil, watercolour, mixed media. I'm drawn to bold, confident colours and subjects ranging from animals to portraits, from nature to abstraction.

floristry.title: Floristry
floristry.text: Over ten years as a florist, currently at Öölill — working with flowers has taught composition, seasonality and handling colour in an organic way.

hairdressing.title: Hairdressing
hairdressing.text: An equally long career as a hairdresser taught precision, a sense of form and working with people — skills that carry into every creative project.

milestones.text: Diplomas in Drawing & Painting and in Children's Book Illustration.
Association of Animal Artists UK — exhibitions and recognition.
Creating new work, exhibiting, and sharing pieces here in the gallery.
